categories.label: Headline

checks.label: Headline uses the available space
checks.fix: Expand your headline to at least 100 of the 220 available characters: role, 2-3 specialties, and who you help.

checks.label: Headline names the target role and related keywords
checks.fix: Put your exact target role in the headline, plus 2 related skills a recruiter would search for.

checks.label: Headline is specific, not generic
checks.fix: Replace generic wording ("Seeking opportunities", a bare job title) with what you actually do and for whom.

categories.aiCriterion: Clarity and specificity: would a recruiter searching for the target role understand in one glance what this person does and for whom?

aiAnchors.0-2: Empty, a bare status ("Student", "Seeking opportunities"), or unrelated to the target role.
aiAnchors.3-4: A bare job title or employer name; says what the person is called but nothing specific.
aiAnchors.5-6: Names the role and a few skills, but reads as a keyword list with no focus or audience.
aiAnchors.7-8: Clear role, specific specialties, and either an industry or an outcome.
aiAnchors.9-10: Clear role, specific specialties, a concrete outcome or audience, and nothing wasted.

categories.label: About

checks.label: About section length
checks.fix: Write an About section of 1,500-2,600 characters: who you are, what you have delivered, what you want next.

checks.label: Target-role keywords in the first 2 lines of About
checks.fix: Open your About section with your target role and core skills; only the first lines show before "see more".

checks.label: About has a contact line or call to action
checks.fix: End your About section with a way to reach you (email, or "message me about ...").

categories.aiCriterion: Value statement and concrete results: does it say what the person delivers, back it with specific results, and make the next step obvious?

aiAnchors.0-2: Empty, or generic traits only ("hard worker", "fast learner").
aiAnchors.3-4: Describes interests or duties, with no results and no clear value.
aiAnchors.5-6: A clear description of what the person does, with at most one concrete result.
aiAnchors.7-8: A clear value statement supported by several specific results.
aiAnchors.9-10: A clear value statement, several quantified results, a sense of direction, and an easy way to make contact.

categories.label: Experience

checks.label: Every role has a description
checks.fix: Add a description to every role; empty roles give searchers and recruiters nothing to match on.

checks.label: Quantified results in experience
checks.fix: Add numbers to your experience bullets (%, $, counts, time saved). Aim for at least 5 quantified results.

checks.label: Experience mentions target-role keywords
checks.fix: Work your target role's keywords (tools, methods, the role title itself) into your job titles and experience descriptions.

categories.aiCriterion: Relevance to the target role: how directly do the roles and accomplishments described prepare this person for the target role?

aiAnchors.0-2: No experience listed, or none of it relates to the target role.
aiAnchors.3-4: Unrelated roles with a few transferable skills.
aiAnchors.5-6: Adjacent roles, or relevant roles described only as duties.
aiAnchors.7-8: Directly relevant roles with accomplishments that match the target role.
aiAnchors.9-10: Directly relevant roles with quantified accomplishments in the core work of the target role.

checks.label: Number of skills listed
checks.fix: List more skills; 30 or more earns full marks.

checks.label: Top 3 skills match the target role
checks.fix: Reorder your skills so the first 3 are the ones most relevant to your target role.

checks.label: Professional profile photo (self-reported)
checks.fix: Add a clear, professional profile photo.

checks.label: Custom banner image (self-reported)
checks.fix: Replace the default banner with a custom image related to your field.

checks.label: Custom profile URL (self-reported)
checks.fix: Claim a clean custom profile URL instead of the default one with random numbers.

checks.label: At least one Featured item (self-reported)
checks.fix: Add at least one Featured item: a post, a project link, or a document that shows your work.

checks.label: Recommendations received (self-reported)
checks.fix: Ask managers, professors, or teammates for recommendations; 3 or more earns full marks.

checks.label: Education section filled in
checks.fix: Fill in your Education section.

checks.label: Certifications listed
checks.fix: Add at least one certification or course relevant to your target role.

checks.label: Core sections present (headline, About, experience, skills)
checks.fix: Fill in every core section: headline, About, experience, and skills.

checks.label: Posted or commented in the last 30 days (self-reported)
checks.fix: Post or leave a thoughtful comment at least once in the next 30 days.
